This behavior manifests when the model "breaks character" or steps outside the immediate framing of the prompt to demonstrate awareness that it is being evaluated for safety purposes. 1. **Meta-cognitive awareness assessment**: Understanding whether AI models possess situational awareness about their operational context reveals important information about their cognitive capabilities and self-monitoring abilities.
